errors.evidence: The x-axis in the plot does not start at 0; the visible data and axis labels begin after 0, at approximately 0.2.

The description incorrectly states that the data lines begin at epoch 0. The plot shows the data starting at an epoch value greater than 0 (approx. 0.2). This error is repeated for all three data series descriptions.
The blue line (regular members) starts at a loss value of approximately 3.3, not 3.2.
The blue line (regular members) decreases to a value closer to 2.35 at epoch 3.0, not 2.3.
The orange line (members with near-duplicates) does not drop to 1.5 at epoch 1.5. At epoch 1.5, its value is approximately 1.55-1.6. It reaches 1.5 at a later epoch (around 2.25).
